item.title: The Inflation Hedge That Wasn’t
item.description: Out of all the reasons to be bullish on Bitcoin, claims that it is an inflation hedge is the most puzzling one I have encountered.

item.title: Bitcoin as Digital Gold
item.description: “The narrative of “bitcoin is digital gold” has been around for some time. Of all the frameworks used to value bitcoin, it is one of the few we consider having a number of economic merits supporting it.

item.title: Bitcoin Takes All
item.description: A common question I receive is: “What stops anyone from cloning Bitcoin and starting their own cryptocurrency?“ Most common reaction is a tie between confusion and shock when they hear my answer: “Technologically, nothing at all.”
